verdict: A genuine same-p finite coefficient bridge suffices. The existing per-slice final log bound does not contain the needed common-p normalization. U has a true raw 1/Q1 harmonic gain; V has only a single totient denominator and does NOT have a fictitious raw 1/p² gain. Its larger raw scale is nevertheless paid by the original medium geometry. UniformAuxiliarySW is unnecessary for these U/V counting errors; no additional supplier or bad-support premise is needed.

def MediumAtom.sharedPrimitiveUVError (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    (((d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionU
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) -
      TransposedZeroCovariance.primitiveZeroMain (d.q1SliceAtom p)) -
      2 * (((d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionV
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) -
          TransposedZeroCovariance.primitiveZeroMain (d.q1SliceAtom p))
complete_proposed_public_payment_type:
theorem actual_betaL2_gamma1L2_sharedPrimitiveUV_log_payment
    (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 A : ℝ) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧ ∀ d : MediumAtom,
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → x0 ≤ d.scale →
      (∑ n ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta n‖ ^ 2) *
        (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) *
          ‖d.sharedPrimitiveUVError‖ ≤
            3 * (d.scale ^ 2 / (Real.log d.scale) ^ A)

actual_centered_identity.equation: SharedEnergy_asComplex = Σp[rawZero_p -2*V_p +U_p +NZ_p] = Σp(rawZero_p-P0_p) + Σp[(U_p-P0_p)-2*(V_p-P0_p)] + Σp NZ_p.
actual_centered_identity.outside: The exact multiplier is B2(d)*G1L2(d), with B2=Σ original betaCarrier norm beta² and G1L2=Σ primitive p norm original gamma1². The owned upper envelope is 4*V*Q1*(1+log(2V))^eB, eB=(2^B)^2-1.
actual_centered_identity.do_not_identify: P0_p is primitiveZeroMain(d.q1SliceAtom p), not one original primitiveZeroMain(d). q1SliceAtom changes only gamma1 to its p Kronecker label: alpha, beta, U,V,Q2,Q3,residue, interval and common smoothing remain literal original values.

old_ZeroUVPayment.scope_audit: Each owned old bound pays original betaL2 only, with no primitive gamma1L2 multiplier and no Σp same-p normalization. actual_signedError_sq_le_nonzero_add_log_payment concerns the unsliced full three-factor route.
old_ZeroUVPayment.why_not_direct_slice: Applying the final old log bound to every d_p and then multiplying G1L2 incurs card(P)*G1L2 ≲Q1². Q1 may be a power of scale; no fixed extra log exponent pays this. Old per-slice U/V power exponents multiplied by Q1² also need not stay below2 at the actual small sigma.
old_ZeroUVPayment.what_can_be_reused: The actual finite U/V expansions and counting-error suppliers are sufficient and already proved; refine their grouped coefficient envelopes before taking away the physical denominators. Existing U/V power/log asymptotic APIs then pay the sharpened shared scales.

finite_bridge.preferred_generic_weighted_slice_bridge: For p in the actual carrier and every f:Nat→Real with f>=0, Σq∈(d_p).physicalFactorModuli norm((d_p).groupedFactorGamma q)*f(q) <= Σu∈factorCarrier Q2×factorCarrier Q3 norm(gamma2 u1*gamma3 u2)*f(p*u1*u2).
finite_bridge.proof_basis: Unfold the actual groupedFactorGamma as its original label fiber, apply norm_sum_le, finite fiberwise summation, and collapse gamma1 of d_p by its exact Kronecker condition. physicalFactorModuli of the slice is the original full Q1×Q2×Q3 image, so do not incorrectly redefine it as just p times the tail image; the inactive coefficients must actually be removed by this finite identity/inequality.
finite_bridge.uniform_physical_denominators: For v=u1*u2>0 retain the full φ(pv) and use 1/φ(pv)<=tau(pv)/(pv)<=tau(p)tau(v)/(pv). This holds for composite p,v with common factors. No multiplicativity φ(pv)=φ(p)φ(v) is assumed.
finite_bridge.norm_masses: The actual owned coprimeMass_norm_le_twice_U and coprimeNormMass_le_twice_U pay the two original alpha masses by 4U²; the same alpha carrier and both interval endpoints remain in every slice.
finite_bridge.active_residue: The owned actualV_sub_primitive_finite_bound already discharges the active q primitive-residue gate. It can be applied to d_p using the owned mediumAdmissible_q1SliceAtom; no new gcd(a,q)=1 premise is introduced. A direct-label reproof must keep the original gamma zero cases and the p.Coprime residue gate.

U_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.actual_coefficient: primitivePairCoefficient(d_p,q,r)=Gamma_p(q)*star Gamma_p(r)*Mass_alpha(q)*star Mass_alpha(r)/(phi(q)*phi(r)). Actual uniform smooth coprime-count error costs C*tau(q*r).
U_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.physical_pointwise: At q=p*v,r=p*w, tau(qr)<=tau(q)tau(r), so norm coefficient*tau(qr) <=4U² * [tau(p)^4/p²] * [tau(v)^2/v] * [tau(w)^2/w] before the original tail label norms. This keeps p² in the denominator; it does not require p prime.
U_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.moment_Ap: A_p=Σq norm Gamma_p(q)*tau(q)/phi(q) <=tau(p)^2/p * H2^4*H3^4, Hj=1+log(2Qj), by the actual weighted-slice bridge and native fixed-order harmonic divisor means at order4 on EACH original tail factor.
U_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.kernel_bound: The proof of owned actualU_finite_envelope_le contains the sharper algebraic intermediate ∑q,r norm primitivePairCoefficient*tau(qr) <=4U²*A_p², before replacing A_p by the old full-cap log bound. Reuse/prove that explicit finite inequality, rather than calling its already-coarsened conclusion.
U_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.sum_p: Σp∈actual primitive carrier tau(p)^4/p² <= H1^16/Q1. Thus Σp norm(U_p-P0_p) <=C_U U²/Q1 * H1^16*H2^8*H3^8 <=C_U U²/Q1 * H^32, H=1+log P, P=8Q1Q2Q3. All factors are genuine fixed moments, no X^epsilon.

V_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.actual_coefficient: mixedPairCoefficient(d_p,q,r)=Gamma_p(q)*star Gamma_p(r)*star Mass_alpha(r)/phi(r). The actual mixed progression discrepancy costs C*NormMass_alpha(q)*tau(r). There is only ONE totient denominator.
V_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.physical_pointwise: At q=p*v,r=p*w the envelope is <=4C U² * norm GammaTail(v)*norm GammaTail(w) * tau(p*w)/phi(p*w), hence <=4C U² * [tau(p)^2/p] * norm GammaTail(v)*norm GammaTail(w)*tau(w)^2/w. Do not insert a second 1/p.
V_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.moments: The weighted slice moment A_p above contributes tau(p)^2/p *H2^4 H3^4. The unweighted slice gamma norm sum can be bounded by the actual original tail-label cardinal <=(2Q2)*(2Q3)=T=4Q2Q3. Therefore each p error <=C_V U²*T*tau(p)^2/p *H2^4 H3^4.
V_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.sum_p: Σp tau(p)^2/p<=H1^4. Thus Σp norm(V_p-P0_p)<=C_V U²*T*H1^4*H2^4*H3^4<=C_V U²*T*H^12.
V_sharp_shared_finite_envelope.safe_alternative: If using the already drafted exact two-factor complex grouping G(v) instead of a fresh carrier-cardinality bound, norm G(v)<=tau(v), Σv<=T tau(v)<=T H_T and Σw tau(w)^3/w<=H_T^8 yield the equally sufficient conservative H^13. This does not use unowned private G symbols; extract the finite argument locally or expose a separately authorized public finite API.

combined_finite_target: Σp[norm(U_p-P0_p)+2*norm(V_p-P0_p)] <=C U² [ H^32/Q1 + T*H^13 ]. The norm of the literal shared complex UV object is <= this sum by finite triangle and norm(2z)=2norm z. A simpler single H^32*(1/Q1+T) envelope is also sufficient since H>=1.

actual_outside_scale_payment.U: B2*G1L2*Σp norm(U_p-P0_p) <=4C_U V*U²*Hbeta^eB*H^32 =4C_U X*U*fixedLogs. The owned U_le_scale_half gives U<=X^(1/2); absorb fixed logs by X^(1/4), obtaining C X^(7/4), then every requested logarithmic decay.
actual_outside_scale_payment.V: B2*G1L2*Σp norm(V_p-P0_p) <=4C_V V*Q1*U²*T*Hbeta^eB*H^13 =4C_V X*(U Q1 T)*fixedLogs. Since P=2Q1T, the owned U_mul_physicalFactorCap_le gives U Q1 T=(U P)/2<=4X^(1-9sigma). Therefore the true V shared outside cost is <=16C_V X^(2-9sigma)*fixedLogs. Absorb fixed logs by X^sigma to get C X^(2-8sigma), then every log budget.
actual_outside_scale_payment.no_extra_geometry: Only the original Q1<U X^-sigma, U²Q2Q3²<X^(1-8sigma), Qj>=1 and sigma>0 are used, exactly through already owned U_le_scale_half and U_mul_physicalFactorCap_le. No stronger sigma or aux support assumption is needed.
actual_outside_scale_payment.quantifier_order: The finite counting constants precede all atoms/moduli/residues. The log threshold is selected from fixed B,sigma,kappa,c0,A before d, so one threshold works for F(i) with every varying original field. UniformAuxiliarySW is not needed for U/V; it remains needed in the separate low-conductor raw-zero estimate.

actual_owned_APIs.full_public_header:
theorem actualU_sub_primitive_finite_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d →
      ‖(d.transposedAtom.complexDispersionU d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) - primitiveZeroMain d‖ ≤
          C * ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
            ‖primitivePairCoefficient d q r‖ * ((q * r).divisors.card : ℝ)

theorem actualV_sub_primitive_finite_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d →
      ‖(d.transposedAtom.complexDispersionV d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) - primitiveZeroMain d‖ ≤
        C * ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
          ‖mixedPairCoefficient d q r‖ *
            coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier (fun n ↦ ‖d.alpha n‖) q *
              (r.divisors.card : ℝ)

theorem coprimeMass_norm_le_twice_U
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (q : ℕ) :
    ‖coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha q‖ ≤ 2 * d.U

theorem coprimeNormMass_le_twice_U
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (q : ℕ) :
    coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier (fun n ↦ ‖d.alpha n‖) q ≤ 2 * d.U

theorem U_le_scale_half
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hsigma : 0 < sigma) (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    d.U ≤ d.scale ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

theorem eventually_actual_log_cost_le_rpow (p s : ℕ) (sigma : ℝ)
    (hsigma : 0 < sigma) {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → x0 ≤ d.scale →
      (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ p *
        (1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap) ^ s ≤ d.scale ^ epsilon

theorem eventually_const_rpow_two_le_logBudget (C A : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, C * x ^ (2 - delta) ≤ x ^ 2 / (Real.log x) ^ A

theorem MediumAtom.U_mul_physicalFactorCap_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    d.U * d.physicalFactorCap ≤ 8 * d.scale ^ (1 - 9 * sigma)

theorem MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactor_outside_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) ≤
        4 * d.V * d.Q1 * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1)
